title.narrative: Bolstering Integrity in Public Contracting: A Reinvigorated Approach and Coalition to the Integrity Pact

description.narrative: The goal of the project is to revamp reframe the integrity pact (IP) as a golden standard for collective action on clean contracting and expand global and national multi-stakeholder coalitions promoting its adoption in strategic public investments. Key objectives include:(i) developing a new IP standard in consultation with the movement and policy experts; (ii) developing a global advocacy strategy to promote the use of IPs and use it to build a multi-stakeholder coalition; and (iii) embedding the new IP standard in national legislation or contracting projects in Argentina, Spain, and Romania.Value of contract: EUR 1,000,000

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany.The countries involved are Argentina, Romania, and Spain.
